phases.title: Skill/Plugin Metadata Governance
phases.objective: Define STRIX-owned metadata and governance contracts for defensive skills, workflows, and future extensions without runtime plugin loading.
phases.observed_hermes_pattern: Hermes uses SKILL.md catalogs, optional skill roots, plugin.yaml manifests, indexes, reload commands, and provider/platform plugin directories.
phases.current_equivalent: STRIX has deterministic defensive workflows in saga_fusion/workflows, PatternRegistry entries, docs-only extensions/hermes_patterns, and no runtime plugin host.
phases.gap: No formal extension manifest schema, provenance fields, risk tier, disabled-by-default lifecycle, allowlisted roots, or safe authoring checklist.
phases.clean_room_strategy: Create a STRIX schema/documentation package and static validators for metadata only. Treat all extension text as untrusted data; no dynamic import, no execution, no Hermes content ingestion.
expected_files: tests/* only if a later implementation phase explicitly adds validators
required_tests: metadata schema validation rejects missing provenance/risk tier
untrusted skill text cannot enter system/developer prompts
risks: untrusted instructions imported as active prompts
what_not_to_do: do not implement a plugin host
phases.current_strix_saga_fusion_equivalent: STRIX has deterministic defensive workflows in saga_fusion/workflows, PatternRegistry entries, docs-only extensions/hermes_patterns, and no runtime plugin host.
do_not_do: do not implement a plugin host

phases.title: Toolset Scoping + Tool Loop Guardrails
phases.objective: Strengthen Saga Fusion tool scope design and loop/failure boundaries while preserving ToolRouter, ApprovalVerifier, and SandboxController authority.
phases.observed_hermes_pattern: Hermes has tool kind mappings, idempotent/mutating taxonomy, toolset scoping, API toolset checks, no-progress and repeated-failure guardrails.
phases.current_equivalent: STRIX has saga_fusion/tool_routing, tool_guard, MissionPolicy, DangerousActionPolicy, and declarative execution plans.
phases.gap: Limited explicit loop/no-progress counters, per-tool scope budgets, and mutating/idempotent evidence vocabulary for future adapters.
phases.clean_room_strategy: Design STRIX-native tool scope metadata and circuit-breaker criteria. Mutating tools always require policy/approval/sandbox checks; repeated failures become blocked evidence, not retries forever.
risks: repeated real operations in later adapters
acceptance_criteria: tool scopes map to STRIX risk model
no external tool execution in tests
what_not_to_do: do not add Hermes gateway toolsets
do not add a parallel tool runtime
do not execute external pentest/CloudOps/Telegram real
phases.current_strix_saga_fusion_equivalent: STRIX has saga_fusion/tool_routing, tool_guard, MissionPolicy, DangerousActionPolicy, and declarative execution plans.
do_not_do: do not add Hermes gateway toolsets
do not add a parallel tool runtime
do not execute external pentest/CloudOps/Telegram real

phases.title: Dry-Run Scheduler/Cron Patterns
phases.objective: Design non-executing scheduled audit specifications with explicit timezone, owner, scope, budgets, and evidence manifests.
phases.observed_hermes_pattern: Hermes includes cron scheduler/jobs/CLI tests for next-run calculation, workdir handling, context sources, inactivity timeout, file permissions, and delivery paths.
phases.current_equivalent: STRIX has no active Saga cron module; workflows/task plans/reporting are interactive and evidence-only.
phases.gap: No schedule policy, dry-run job spec, per-job evidence manifest, timezone capture, stale-approval handling, or delivery traceability.
phases.clean_room_strategy: Start with docs and dry-run schedule plan objects only. Scheduled jobs may produce plans/reports but may not execute actions; future execution requires R4 approval and SandboxController.
expected_files: saga_fusion/scheduler/* only in later approved implementation
tests/scheduler/* only in later approved implementation
required_tests: R4/R5 scheduled intents do not execute
phases.current_strix_saga_fusion_equivalent: STRIX has no active Saga cron module; workflows/task plans/reporting are interactive and evidence-only.

phases.title: Session Recovery + Context Compression Safety
phases.objective: Design STRIX-owned recovery and compaction rules that preserve user/session routing, approvals, policy constraints, and redaction boundaries.
phases.observed_hermes_pattern: Hermes has gateway session persistence, restart/pending drain, task-local context, session expiry, context compression, protected head/tail, structured summaries, tool-output pruning, and compaction tests.
phases.current_equivalent: STRIX has Telegram gating, mission memory, context windows, session summarizer, prompt builder, and non-authoritative memory policy.
phases.gap: No persistent restart-drain state machine, no route recovery design, no token-aware compressor, and no compaction-boundary regression matrix.
phases.clean_room_strategy: Design a STRIX recovery state machine and compaction template where summaries are explicitly non-authoritative. Never compress away R4/R5 policy, SandboxController boundary, redaction requirements, approval IDs/action hashes, or current user routing.
expected_files: tests/memory/* or tests/session_recovery/* if implementation approved
required_tests: secret text is redacted before/after compaction
what_not_to_do: do not let summaries change policy
phases.current_strix_saga_fusion_equivalent: STRIX has Telegram gating, mission memory, context windows, session summarizer, prompt builder, and non-authoritative memory policy.
do_not_do: do not let summaries change policy

phases.title: Evidence/Reporting Manifests
phases.objective: Standardize evidence/report artifact manifests with provenance, phase, redaction, validation, and delivery metadata.
phases.observed_hermes_pattern: Hermes uses trajectories/evidence stores, dashboard/package manifests, delivery notices, and reporting tests.
phases.current_equivalent: STRIX has saga_fusion/reporting, evidence logs, phase reports, TEST_RESULTS_SUMMARY, SECURITY_REGRESSION_REPORT, and risk register updates.
phases.gap: Artifact manifests are not yet a single standardized schema across phase reports, evidence JSON, redaction status, and test provenance.
phases.clean_room_strategy: Define a STRIX manifest schema for generated evidence and reports. Include source phase/commit, generator, redaction status, validation commands/results, and non-secret delivery references.
expected_files: reports/evidence/* only if generated by STRIX-owned code
phases.current_strix_saga_fusion_equivalent: STRIX has saga_fusion/reporting, evidence logs, phase reports, TEST_RESULTS_SUMMARY, SECURITY_REGRESSION_REPORT, and risk register updates.

phases.title: LLM Error Taxonomy + Recovery
phases.objective: Design centralized LLM/provider error classification and recovery reporting without automatic credential rotation or unapproved fallback.
phases.observed_hermes_pattern: Hermes classifies API errors and suggests retry, credential rotation, fallback, compression, abort, and provider-specific recovery paths.
phases.current_equivalent: STRIX LLM gateway is disabled by default, env-driven, redacted, mocked in tests, with safe router fallback and no tool execution from brain output.
phases.gap: No central error taxonomy, retry budget evidence, or safe fallback decision record for LLM failures.
phases.clean_room_strategy: Classify errors into transient, auth, rate-limit, context-length, safety, provider, and unknown categories. Recovery is reporting-first; no credential rotation, no hidden provider fallback, no policy downgrade.
required_tests: auth failures do not retry indefinitely
context error suggests compression without policy loss
what_not_to_do: do not call real LLM in tests
do not rotate or read secrets
phases.current_strix_saga_fusion_equivalent: STRIX LLM gateway is disabled by default, env-driven, redacted, mocked in tests, with safe router fallback and no tool execution from brain output.
do_not_do: do not call real LLM in tests
do not rotate or read secrets

phases.title: Approval Timeout + Regression Depth
phases.objective: Expand design and tests for timeout-to-deny, stale approvals, channel-specific audit outcomes, and risk-based regression categories.
phases.observed_hermes_pattern: Hermes approval tests cover allow/deny callbacks, timeout-to-deny behavior, CLI/gateway approval UI, restart cases, cron/session/tool regression breadth.
phases.current_equivalent: STRIX has ApprovalVerifier, Telegram approval workflow, approval IDs, action hashes, replay protection, R4 approval-required, and R5 blocked.
phases.gap: Need explicit multi-channel timeout-to-deny regression design, stale scheduled approval handling, and matrix coverage across scheduler/session/tool/error/manifest features.
phases.clean_room_strategy: Codify R4 timeout as deny, never allow-always. Require exact action hash and current session/user/channel; expand regression matrix with docs-first acceptance before future code.
phases.current_strix_saga_fusion_equivalent: STRIX has ApprovalVerifier, Telegram approval workflow, approval IDs, action hashes, replay protection, R4 approval-required, and R5 blocked.
